The organisation’s structured geography in the supplied records is South Australia (SA). The only descriptive material captured from the organisation’s website in the evidence pack is the name/brand “Campbelltown CCC”; no program descriptions, service models, participation opportunities or beneficiary lists were included in the provided website snapshot. The ACNC AIS extract supplied financial figures but no additional program detail in the evidence provided.
